cost_assumptions.relocation_rule: removes one device from its origin and adds one at its destination
cost_assumptions.locked_in_place_default: retain at least one confirmed AED per existing building-floor group; only surplus co-located devices may relocate
cost_assumptions.candidate_eligibility: simulated placeholder; every recommendation requires UTD review
cost_assumptions.candidate_shortlist: 15 highest standalone gap-closing building sites; one lowest-floor eligible common-area site per building
cost_assumptions.demand_aggregation: building-floor groups; route quality demand-weighted within group

pilot_assumptions.scope: Test-pilot assumptions only; not independently verified UTD operational facts

authoritative_data_needed: complete AED inventory and operational/maintenance status
room capacities, schedules, residence populations, and event attendance
procurement, installation, relocation, and maintenance costs
